nodes.label: GoHappy Club
nodes.brief: Full Stack Developer — wellness & community platform for seniors, 17,000+ MAU.

drawerDetails.description: Built and scaled a senior-citizen wellness and community platform end-to-end as the sole engineer across mobile, backend, admin, and web. The platform serves 17,000+ monthly active users with 55,000+ total downloads across iOS and Android.

workstreams.title: Mobile Client (React Native)
workstreams.description: Sole mobile engineer — built the entire iOS + Android app from scratch. 40+ screens, OTA updates via Revopush, PhonePe/Paytring payments, Branch.io deep linking to 30+ screens, i18n in 5 Indian languages, CI/CD via GitHub Actions + EAS Build, and 1500+ commits over 2 years.

workstreams.title: Backend (Spring Boot)
workstreams.description: Sole backend developer — ~697 commits (75% of total). Built the complete subscription lifecycle, PhonePe UPI autopay, gamification engine (spin wheel with 2-tier weighted algorithm, scratch cards, coin economy), BigQuery analytics pipeline, Neodove CRM integration, and migrated all cron jobs to Google Cloud Scheduler.

workstreams.title: Admin Dashboard (React)
workstreams.description: Sole frontend developer — built the entire admin portal from scratch with 22+ feature pages. Includes a live Tambola game board with 90 traditional rhymes, a 5-tab Spin Wheel admin, full analytics suite with Chart.js/Nivo, NGO campaign lifecycle management, JWT auth with role-based access control, and dark/light theme with RTL support.

workstreams.title: Web Portal (React)
workstreams.description: Sole frontend developer — built the public-facing SPA with 15 routes. Full PhonePe UPI payment flow (VPA + QR), membership subscription, trip/tour pages, Zoom meeting redirect with early-joiner lock, Neodove CRM integration, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions + FTP deploy to Hostinger.

nodes.label: Dr. UPSC
nodes.brief: Frontend Developer — EdTech platform for UPSC aspirants, 15,000+ MAU.

drawerDetails.description: Designed and built a full-featured UPSC EdTech web platform from scratch as the sole frontend engineer — 82 pages, 184 components, 45K+ lines. Features include Shaka Player video streaming, a mock test engine with question prefetching, dual payment gateways (Razorpay + Cashfree), mentorship booking, e-commerce store, CleverTap analytics, and interactive seasonal animations.

nodes.label: MayaX
nodes.brief: AI-driven interior design platform — upload a room photo, get a styled transformation.

drawerDetails.description: A React Native app where users upload room photos and receive AI-generated interior design transformations. Built a Flask backend with Supabase, a custom Stable Diffusion inference pipeline, and on-device Llama 3.2 1B via ExecuTorch for offline prompt refinement. Includes a full data pipeline: Pexels/Unsplash scrapers, LLaVA auto-captioning, and LoRA fine-tuning.

nodes.label: Glitch
nodes.brief: Peer-authenticated screen time blocker — friends must approve to unlock your phone.

drawerDetails.description: A cross-platform screen-time management app built with React Native, using custom native modules to interface directly with OS-level APIs for usage tracking and app restrictions. The core innovation is a peer-group approval system — unlocking restricted sessions requires consensus from friends, preventing users from bypassing their own limits.

nodes.label: Blockex
nodes.brief: Native Safari extension (macOS + iOS) that blocks websites and hides YouTube Shorts.

drawerDetails.description: A native Safari browser extension built with Swift and JavaScript (Manifest V3). Implements dual-layer URL blocking via declarativeNetRequest + DOM fallback, YouTube Shorts hiding with MutationObserver for SPA navigation detection, and a cross-platform popup UI with dark mode. Zero external dependencies — every line is hand-written against native platform APIs.

nodes.label: C_Helper
nodes.brief: Local crypto signal intelligence platform — LLM-confirmed trade setups via technical analysis.

drawerDetails.description: A personal crypto signal platform that watches BTC, ETH, SOL, and XRP across multiple timeframes. Features a gate-based strategy engine (6 active strategies), Smart Money Concepts detection (FVGs, Order Blocks, BOS, CHoCH), multi-timeframe confluence, LLM confirmation via local LM Studio or OpenRouter, real-time WebSocket scanning with gap healing, full backtesting engine (685 lines), and Telegram delivery.

nodes.label: Peer Focus
nodes.brief: Real-time collaborative focus rooms with synchronized Pomodoro timers and peer accountability.

drawerDetails.description: A web app where peers join shared rooms with synchronized Pomodoro-style timers and goal tracking. Built with a dual-backend abstraction layer — switching between Supabase and Firebase requires a single env var change. Features a canvas-drawn HiDPI analog timer, client-side tick engine with 5s debounced DB sync, auto-pause on tab close via fetch keepalive, and real-time goal updates across all peers.

nodes.label: Wallulu
nodes.brief: Wallpaper discovery app — browse, filter, and download high-quality wallpapers.

drawerDetails.description: A React Native (Expo) wallpaper browsing app using the Pixabay API. Features a responsive masonry grid with dynamic image sizing, debounced search, 21 category filters, an advanced filter modal (orientation, image type, 11 color filters), infinite scroll pagination, and full-screen image preview.

nodes.label: SKIT Jaipur
nodes.brief: B.Tech in Computer Science — CGPA 8.48, graduating May 2026.

drawerDetails.description: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Swami Keshvanand Institute of Technology, Management & Gramothan, Jaipur. CGPA: 8.48. Core coursework in Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, DBMS, Operating Systems, and OOP.
